**THE FEED** · Thursday 20 August 2026

**YOUTUBE IS PAYING CREATORS MILLIONS TO STAY AWAY FROM NETFLIX**
Bloomberg reported yesterday that YouTube is offering top creators multi-million dollar packages for exclusivity.  Part of the offer is a guaranteed cut of brand deals YouTube itself brokers.  Read that sentence twice if you buy creator media.

**1.** YouTube is reportedly offering top creators millions for exclusivity, including a guaranteed cut of brand deals YouTube itself brokers, and penalising those who sign with Netflix.  Ask your biggest creator partners whether they have had that offer, and write direct-negotiation rights into your next contract.
**2.** From Monday, YouTube counts a view from the first frame, which inflates the denominator and drops engagement rates by roughly a quarter without anybody disengaging.  Export your view, engagement and comment baselines before Monday morning and date-stamp the change in your reporting.
**3.** BetterHelp went from about 4 new followers a day to about 450 by commenting on other people's posts rather than advertising, at a cost of one person for 20 hours a week.  Give one person 15 hours a week and a written rule about which conversations you are allowed in, then measure it against your paid social.
**4.** Community co-streamers now generate 50.5% of all watch time at the Esports World Cup, more than the official broadcasts.  Ask your next event partner for the co-casting split by language and buy the top three co-streamers separately.
**5.** A sponsored video for Manuel Enrique, a 2.99 million subscriber creator no trade has profiled, beat his best organic video by 75% and hit 11.1 million views, and the brand bought four more that week.  Price a four-Short run with him before a second outlet covers him.
**6.** Neutrogena stayed silent for two days while mentions rose 47,661% and unfavourable sentiment climbed to 79.5%, because nobody had authority to approve a statement over a weekend.  Write down this week who can approve a brand statement inside two hours on a Saturday, plus a deputy for each of them.
**7.** Nuuly shot a 12-episode drama in about four weeks and released it in four batches of three on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube with the brand as a supporting character.  Price a twelve-episode version of your next hero film and plan the release in four batches instead of one.
